message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | # | Rule | Details | |---|------|---------| | 1 | **Objective** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by winning rounds and by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | 2 | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down to form the draw pile.
• Turn over the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | 3 | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). | | 4 | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card from your hand if it matches the discard pile’s top card by:
• Color (red, yellow, green, blue).
• Number (0–9).
• Symbol (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, Wild Draw Four).
If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | 5 | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Changes play direction (two‑player games act like Skip).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | 6 | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you fail to call UNO and another player notices before the next turn starts, you must draw two penalty cards. | | 7 | **Winning a Round** | A round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Draw Two, Skip, Reverse = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | 8 | **Winning the Game** | The first player to reach or exceed the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Play Tips 1. **Keep a Variety of Colors** – Having multiple colors reduces the chance you’ll be stuck drawing cards. 2. **Use Wilds Strategically** – Save Wild Draw Four for when you’re sure you have no matching color, or use it to block an opponent who’s close to winning. 3. **Watch Opponents’ Hands** – If someone is down to one card, they’ll shout “UNO.” Keep an eye on who’s about to win. 4. **Challenge Wisely** – Only challenge a Wild Draw Four if you’re confident the player had no matching color; a wrong challenge forces you to draw four cards. Enjoy playing Uno!
